helper: CP one-sided 95 pct lower = Beta^-1(0.05; k, n-k+1), bisection on the regularized incomplete beta
inversion_bug_note: an earlier draft solved I_x(a,b)=0.95 and returned bounds ABOVE p_hat; the assertion cp95_lower<=k/n on every row caught it, and the target is 0.05.
why: the shipped floor number is a CP lower bound, so the helper is calibrated BEFORE use: if it returned the upper limit (an inversion bug this package actually hit and fixed) every reported bound would be wrong in the unsafe direction
